title: I subscribed to this since October 2021.
text: Obviously, I’ve had amazing boxes and so so boxes.  The reason I’m writing this review is the last two boxes were such a disappointment!!!  I’ve gotten the same plants two months in a row.  The same succulents each month and the quality is diminishing.  Just be aware of what you are getting.  I’m giving this one more month and that’s it.  I love monthly subscriptions gives me a little pick me up etc.  If this is something that you only want for a few months.  I think you’ll probably like it.  Unfortunately, so far this isn’t working out as a long time company to stay with.
label: negative
